title: Participation in federal program.
bodyText:
[MANPOWER DEVELOPMENT AND TRAINING]

The department of labor and industrial relations and the University of Hawaii are authorized to participate in the Manpower Development and Training Act of 1962, as amended, by providing from funds appropriated by the legislature for such purpose, in accordance with and to the extent required by the federal act, amounts necessary to match the amounts expended by the United States Treasury.
crossReferences: Establishment of manpower development and training programs, see chapter 394.

[MANPOWER DEVELOPMENT AND TRAINING]

 

     [§202-21  Participation in federal program.]  The department of labor and industrial relations and the University of Hawaii are authorized to participate in the Manpower Development and Training Act of 1962, as amended, by providing from funds appropriated by the legislature for such purpose, in accordance with and to the extent required by the federal act, amounts necessary to match the amounts expended by the United States Treasury. [L 1964, c 11, §2; am L 1965, c 23, §1; am L 1968, c 71, §5; HRS §202-21]
